text_block_list.text: And so, the curtain fell on my first three years with Vodka.

"Even so, this doesn't mean our connection is severed.
We will keep aiming even further—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Farewell—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It is what it is.
Farewells are bound to happen eventually.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Dragging things out and clinging to lingering regrets forever just isn't like me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The season where we could run together is over.
That's all there is to it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The wind gave me the answer. We simply
crossed paths on a long journey...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"There's no end to this struggle.
Beyond that mountain pass... no, beyond this very sky..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I didn't read it! I just happened to glance at
the manga my dad was reading, is all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thanks for everything up till now.
From here on out, I'm dashing ahead alone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Â¡AdiÃ³s!

Leaving behind a greeting in some incomprehensible language,
Vodka dashed off dashingly...
Wishing them the best of luck, I head back to the academy while pondering our next move...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!"
A familiar face came chasing after me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, this is bad!
We got separated—what the heck do we do now?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's only 'cause you handled everything
that I was able to look so cool, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If we break up, I'll just go right back
to being uncool, you know!
choice_data_list: And after making such a cool exit, too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad! I didn't mean anything by it!
I guess I just got a little carried away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You know how it is, right?
Those times when you just get way ahead of yourself—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaah!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is... Dad. The most uncool thing he does
when he gets down on his knees to apologize to Mom...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So lame... Trainer,
I guess I've still got a long way to go.

No matter how cool he tries to act,
it seems there are still plenty of unpolished edges.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, there's no way in hell I'm saying goodbye!
Just look at the sorry state things are in.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on ya, partner, help me out here. Let's keep
riding tandem together from here on out, deal?!
